**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error.'**

It's good to travel and / work, most beautiful than going / to the same office each day.

options.text: to the same office each day.

solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"work, most beautiful than going."**
